nodes.title: orrery
widgets_values:
## orrery · H3 RefMod reel (a character who comes back)

@JINX leaves the frame, the room stays empty for a clip, and she slides back in. The clip in between never names her, so it goes without her RefMod; the clips that name her get it. Her RefMod (`minimaxh3_jinx_v1_refmod`, Apache 2.0, from [malcolmrey/minimaxh3](https://huggingface.co/malcolmrey/minimaxh3)) ships with orrery in `examples/refmods`; RefMods of your own go into `models/refmods`.

**Orrery RefMods** puts each clip's RefMods on Reference to Video's conditioning, each with a strength, a start and an end (`SET: @JINX(1, 0%, 10%)`), and builds the ones a `REMEMBER: every 10th frame as refmod NAME` line makes from the reel's own frames with the VAE wired into it. Loading RefMod files needs the [ComfyUI-H3RefMods](https://github.com/FranckyB/ComfyUI-H3RefMods) pack. Clips are chained by **Orrery Continue** / **Orrery Film** as in the reel workflow; Orrery Refs stays in for pictures of your own (`@NAME (image 3)`).

The **Orrery Prompt** node is the whole of orrery: write in its **Prompt** tab (this workflow opens with a quickstart; **New** has the other modes), roll it in **Test** without queueing, and rate what comes out in **Gallery**: the ratings steer the next rolls. **Roll** in the node queues this graph (next N clips or images: how many runs); what the Save node writes is logged to the gallery with the picks that made it.

- `seed` drives the rolls and the sampler (Random Noise).
- `LORA:` lines come out on `lora_stack`, for a loader with a `lora_stack` input (LoraManager, Efficiency …), which is not part of this core-nodes workflow.

[orrery on GitHub](https://github.com/pyros-projects/ComfyUI-orrery) · [the prompt language](https://github.com/pyros-projects/ComfyUI-orrery/blob/main/docs/dsl.md) · [H3 screenplays](https://github.com/pyros-projects/ComfyUI-orrery/blob/main/docs/h3.md)

nodes.title: models
widgets_values:
## Models

From [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3):

- `models/diffusion_models/` [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- `models/text_encoders/` [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)
- `models/vae/` [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) and [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

Sampling as in ComfyUI's own H3 templates: `res_multistep`, `simple`, 20 steps, no CFG. For a turbo LoRA from the same repository, put a **LoraLoaderModelOnly** after the model loader and lower the steps (4 to 8, as the LoRA says).

**Model Attention Backend** is set to `comfy kitchen attention`: ComfyUI's own quantized INT8 attention, much faster on Nvidia and AMD GPUs. Where it is not available, the node falls back to PyTorch attention by itself (and says so in the log).

**RefMods:** the [ComfyUI-H3RefMods](https://github.com/FranckyB/ComfyUI-H3RefMods) custom nodes, for loading RefMod files (their Load and Apply nodes are not needed).

@h3 text 9:16
style: live-action, cinematic fashion film, one continuous take
context: 22
$house = __couture_house__
$season = {spring|summer|autumn|winter}
$venue = {IF $season is spring, summer: __cakewalk_outdoor__|__cakewalk_indoor__}

MUSIC: a swaggering brass cakewalk over a slow, heavy techno kick

@lib cakewalk_outdoor
  a long runway of white planks laid across a flowering meadow
  a rooftop runway above the city under an open sky
  a runway along a sunlit harbour pier
  a runway cut through a lavender field
  a runway on a beach of pale sand beside the surf
@lib cakewalk_indoor
  the ballroom of a crumbling palace, lit by chandeliers
  a brutalist concrete hall with one hard spotlight
  an empty museum gallery with polished marble floors
  a disused railway hall strung with warm bulbs
  a glasshouse fogged from inside, its iron frame glowing
@lib cakewalk_women
  a towering model with a severe black bob and razor cheekbones
  a freckled model with a slicked-back copper ponytail
  a model with close-cropped platinum hair and dark brows
  an older model with a sharp silver pixie cut
  a model with waist-long braids gathered into a crown
@lib cakewalk_men
  a lean model with a shaved head and a long jaw
  a broad-shouldered model with a trimmed black beard
  a silver-haired older model with a weathered face
  a model with bleached curls and a single gold earring
  a tall model with a slicked-back undercut
@lib cakewalk_womenswear
  a sculptural ivory gown with a collar like a folded fan
  a crimson latex column dress with opera gloves
  a floor-length coat of liquid silver sequins
  a sheer organza dress over a boxy grey tailored jacket
  a corset gown pieced together from vintage denim
@lib cakewalk_menswear
  a razor-sharp double-breasted suit with wide peaked lapels
  an oversized trench coat cinched with a leather harness
  a cropped tuxedo jacket over wide pleated trousers
  a boiler suit in raw white canvas with exaggerated shoulders
  a long cape of black feathers over a bare chest and tailored trousers

SCENE the curtain
$who = {woman|man}
SHOT 6s: tracking, slow
The $house $season show opens at $venue: the guests settle along both sides of the runway with their phones raised as the lights come up.
IF $season is spring: Blossom drifts across the runway in the breeze.
IF $season is summer: The low sun glares off every lens in the front row.
IF $season is autumn: Rain streaks the tall windows behind the crowd.
IF $season is winter: Snow drifts past the tall windows behind the crowd.
SFX: a murmuring crowd; the first notes of a brass band
END ON: the runway lies empty under the lights, waiting
IF $who is woman: CUT TO: womenswear
CUT TO: menswear

SCENE womenswear
$model = __cakewalk_women__
$look = __cakewalk_womenswear__
$who = {woman|man}
SHOT 6s: tracking, slow
$model struts down the runway toward the camera in $look, high-stepping in time with the brass like an old cakewalk.
IF $season is spring, summer: The open air tugs at the hem as she passes.
IF $season is autumn, winter: Her steps echo off the walls as she passes.
SFX: heel strikes in time with the brass; a ripple of camera shutters
END ON: the model reaches the end of the runway, poses and turns back
IF $who is woman: CUT TO: womenswear
CUT TO: menswear

SCENE menswear
$model = __cakewalk_men__
$look = __cakewalk_menswear__
$who = {woman|man}
SHOT 6s: tracking, slow
$model struts down the runway toward the camera in $look, high-stepping in time with the brass like an old cakewalk.
IF $season is spring, summer: The open air tugs at the coat as he passes.
IF $season is autumn, winter: His steps echo off the walls as he passes.
SFX: hard soles strike in time with the brass; a ripple of camera shutters
END ON: the model reaches the end of the runway, poses and turns back
IF $who is woman: CUT TO: womenswear
CUT TO: menswear
